identity: WB Isilu Persist Attrition. Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn is a {3}{W}{W} 5/5 flying lifelink body that flips for {B} into Isilu, Carrier of Twilight: 'Each other nontoken creature you control has persist.' From that point every creature trades twice, and 5 of the deck's 6 enters-the-battlefield triggers are rebought on the return — the exception is Emptiness, whose ETBs are gated on 'if {W}{W} was spent to cast it', and a persist return is not a cast. The deck is built out of two classes of body the anthem is unusually good with: creatures that enter with -1/-1 counters and shed them for free or for value (Reluctant Dounguard, Moonlit Lamenter), and creatures whose ETB is worth buying a second time (Graveshifter). Nine instant-speed answers hold the game open while that assembles, and Rhys, the Evermore plus Perfect Intimidation strip the persist counter off a returned creature so it becomes persist-eligible a third time — the only two effects in this 282-card pool that can do that to ANOTHER creature.
